name: Report Generation Workflow
description: Phase 6 deterministic report generation playbook. Operator runs `forge report generate --engagement N` with the default `auto` provider cascade: local llama.cpp -> optional free-only OpenRouter model -> deterministic template fallback. Produces Markdown, PDF, HTML, JSON, and CSV reports plus the Maltego workspace and GraphML attack-path exports. Entirely offline-capable; no provider keys are required. The playbook also covers the read-only health commands `report quality-audit`, `report stale-plan`, and `report policy-plan`.
